source: I want to make a 3D game where a team of ice people defend their ice town with a grey wall while a team of players with torches rush to break down the ice people's defenses and melt the city.

answers.ask: How does a round end - a timer the defenders survive, or the whole town melted?
answers.answer: A round ends when the attackers melt the whole town; the ice team wins if they keep any of the town standing until the round timer expires.

answers.ask: Is the town a handful of buildings or a full settlement inside the wall?
answers.answer: Make it a small town with a handful of ice buildings inside the grey wall, so the match area stays compact and playable.

config.prompt:
I want to make a 3D game where a team of ice people defend their ice town with a grey wall while a team of players with torches rush to break down the ice people's defenses and melt the city.

--- clarifications from the author ---
- [goal] How does a round end - a timer the defenders survive, or the whole town melted? A round ends when the attackers melt the whole town; the ice team wins if they keep any of the town standing until the round timer expires.
- [scale] Is the town a handful of buildings or a full settlement inside the wall? Make it a small town with a handful of ice buildings inside the grey wall, so the match area stays compact and playable.
config.genre_evidence: “a team of ice people defend their ice town” while “a team of players with torches rush to break down” defenses creates a compact shared team-versus-team clash space. The timed objective of melting or defending the town adds strategic objectives, but the layout is primarily for direct combat around the wall and buildings.

extras.text: A grey defensive wall encloses the compact town perimeter.
The ice buildings collectively serve as the attackers' meltable round objective; attackers win when all are melted, while defenders win if any remain when the timer expires.

config.evidence: No shape-specific language indicates terraces, overhangs, or a chain of rooms; the prompt only specifies a compact small town inside a wall.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Action map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Flat Arena: A single level floor, free of minor tripping geometry, for the cleanest possible physics.

INCLUDE:
- Breakable Cover: Welded structures that fracture under fire, so cover degrades as the fight goes on.
- Settlement: Built-up ground at a stated density — a hamlet, a town, or a dense city block grid — rather than scattered individual buildings.
- A grey defensive wall encloses the compact town perimeter.
